tasks.title: ws review gains checks and a queue
tasks.summary: The facts a reviewer needs and a UI must not work out.
acceptance: ws review --checks on a task on its branch reads the evidence from the branch and reports the gates settling would run
each acceptance item is paired with its quoted proof, or marked as having none
ws review --checks on a landed task names the commit and runs no gates
ws review --queue lists branch work before landed work, with sizes and a revision that changes on a new commit
both shapes pass their schemas, and plain ws review is unchanged

tasks.title: ws serve: guards, API, SSE
tasks.summary: The server, tested over real HTTP.
acceptance: it binds 127.0.0.1 only and has no host option
a wrong Host, a missing token, a foreign Origin and a non-JSON POST are each refused, and nothing is written
a current POST /api/act commits; a stale one answers 409 with act's line and leaves the tree and HEAD as they were
a static path outside the listing is 404, including traversal
a change to a watched file reaches an open /api/events stream
/api/doc takes a name, never a path

tasks.title: The shell, registry, wave lanes and task detail
tasks.summary: The page itself, with the confirm flow every write passes through.
acceptance: the assets ship as package data, and a test holds that nothing refers to another host
no asset uses innerHTML or eval, and a test holds that
the literals test covers the web assets
the pure helpers have tests that run where Node exists and skip where it doesn't
verify: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -B -m unittest tests.test_serve tests.test_web tests.test_no_project_literals

tasks.title: The review screens
tasks.summary: The queue, then one task: checks, proofs beside their items, and the diff by file. These matter most.
acceptance: the diff parser's line numbers and kinds have tests
the review screen fetches only through /api/review and /api/queue, and a test holds that
verify: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -B -m unittest tests.test_serve tests.test_web tests.test_no_project_literals

tasks.title: Health and context budget
tasks.summary: Findings with the actions they list, Sync where progress is stale, and each role against its limit.
acceptance: the health screen offers only the actions a finding lists, and Sync only on a stale row, and a test holds the wiring
verify: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -B -m unittest tests.test_serve tests.test_web tests.test_no_project_literals

tasks.title: Prove it in a browser, and write down what's true
tasks.summary: Every screen in a real browser, from an installed wheel with no Node, then the docs.

acceptance.text: each screen drawn in a real browser on a sample project
a write that lands and a stale write that's refused, both from the page
the served page came from an installed wheel, with no node on the server's PATH
the plan, README and a decision record say what was and wasn't proven

outOfScope: writing to any real project through the UI
scope.rule: Every fact comes from Python and every write goes through act.act; the page draws and asks.
